consumers: AG1 Dispatch — Wave 6 agricultural scenario layer
contract_notes: Water is represented only as separate diversion and consumptive-use fields.
Ag economics use only Census of Agriculture operations/producers and BEA farm proprietor income (D4).
DOR productive-value fields are coefficients and link to the fiscal ledger; assessed values are not duplicated.

rangeland_acres.notes: AG LAND excl cropland/pastureland/woodland. Excludes pastureland (see pastureland_acres).

land_in_farms_acres.notes: FARM OPERATIONS - ACRES OPERATED (2022 COA); sum of cropland+pastureland+woodland+other_ag.

other_land_acres.derivation: county_area_acres - land_in_farms_acres; never absorbs reconciliation error.

reconciliation_error_acres.notes: (cropland + pastureland + woodland + other_ag) - land_in_farms. Must be 0 or near 0.

forage_acres.notes: Derived: pastureland(excl cropland+woodland) + other_ag_land(excl cropland+pasture+woodland). Proxy only.

stocking_rate_aum_per_acre.notes: State-average estimate: 30 ac/AUM = 0.0333 AUM/ac (NRCS WY Grazing Lands Technical Note range: 20-40 ac/AUM).

aum_capacity.notes: forage_acres × 0.0333 AUM/acre. Confidence low: actual stocking rate varies significantly by range condition and federal allotment.

rap_invasive_cover.geography: county aggregate only; no sub-county invasive claim

check_1_fremont_park_lead_irrigated.finding: 2022 COA ranks Carbon (157,301 ac) and Sublette (120,242 ac) above Park (104,747) and Fremont (101,050). Expectation 'Fremont and Park lead' not confirmed for 2022 vintage.
check_1_fremont_park_lead_irrigated.investigation: Carbon County: North Platte and Encampment River systems support large irrigated hay production; 157K ac is plausible. Sublette County: near-total cropland irrigation (cropland=120,319 ac, irrigated=120,242 ac) consistent with high-altitude semi-arid climate. Fremont/Park: 2022 was a severe drought year for Wyoming — Wind River Indian Reservation (Fremont) and Shoshone/Bighorn Basin (Park) systems likely had below-average diversions. Finding documented, not annotated around.
